corrections.correction: Warren reviews Theler’s Midwest Woodland book. It cannot support Michaud or New England Paleoindians.
Original volume 53(1) is 1999; supplied 2002 is not publication year.
Supplied coastal table misleadingly places Sipp Bay among terminal-Pleistocene contexts. Directly inspected dates are Woodland/Protohistoric.
Brigham legacy BP remains unplaced; dated records use published calibrated ranges only. New Brunswick 11,600–9000 is explicitly cal yr BP.
Mount Desert knives are probable/undated; not excavated encampments or direct boat-harvesting evidence.
Accessed Champlain abstract and point-classification study do not demonstrate direct seal, beluga or walrus hunting.
Table 3 Bull Brook 1/2 labels determinations; not mechanical equivalents of Bull Brook I/II site names.
Debert, Newfoundland shoreline preservation and Kitchel forest change remain in existing staged records.
No artifact, sample or locus counts converted into populations or residence intervals.
Singer repository item is a dissertation; Spiess/Wilson 2021 is a book chapter; Anthropologica item is malformed review metadata.
Online 2025 and print issue 2026 are distinguished; final issue 91(1) is 2026.
